name: Kisaki Naokuni
source:
He lied about his age and pretended to be a high school senior (18 years old).
He received the same assignment as Yahiro and went undercover.
A member of a family of Onmyoji (exorcists) who are enemies of Yahiro.
Very strong. Sarcastic and mean. 

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060629221246fw_/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/akiiro_cyara.html]official website[/url]]
